latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Guide — Create and Export Instructional Videos.

- Upload raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) for guided editing and export.
- Add step-by-step captions, chapter markers, and other enhancements via natural language prompts.
- Exports finished 1080p MP4 videos, typically within 1–2 minutes.
- Built-in credit management and session handling with automatic anonymous token generation.
- Designed for educators and content creators to create structured instructional videos quickly without complex editing tools.
